name: In Favor of the Light
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Hey! adventurer! Got a minute?!

Ya been following the Light now for long enough that you find your way to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos. He'll teach ya more about the path yer following, and if you prove worthy, give ya yer first set of robes to denote your station as a priest.

Now get goin'! As soon as yer done here, head through the tunnel--he'll be waitin' for ya.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Maxan Anvol in Dun Morogh.
narrative.offerRewardText: Oh, so Branstock sent ya, did he? Good, good! He's right, it is 'bout time you started taking a much larger step into the Light. It'll build character and make ya stronger... an' that's what you'll need more than anything: strength of body... strength of will.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 4, 360 XP in all.
